shared_elements: row of repeated rounded/bag-like shapes across the top
horizontal dividing band separating an upper figural zone from lower content
profile figures (quadruped/bird in A, human in B)
repeated small motifs arranged in horizontal rows
justification: Both are tall carved slabs organised into a figural upper zone above horizontal dividing lines, and both show a row of repeated rounded shapes near the top, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a coarse, deeply modelled photograph dominated by large isolated animals with much blank ground, while B is a fine linear drawing of a symmetrical human-figure scene above a dense block of small repeated sign-rows.
